title: For DOWN ports, list the tenant ID, the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports
question: For DOWN ports, list the tenant ID, the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports and average admin_state_up (rounded), along with each port’s security group ID and rank within that security group (by port ID), plus the port name, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, VIF type, the 2-preceding-to-2-following VIF-type window average of admin_state_up (ordered by MAC address), and the normalized ratio of that window average to the tenant’s average admin_state_up for DOWN ports; additionally, for each tenant include the tenant’s total number of ports (all statuses) and the average port count across all tenants.

prediction.sql:
WITH down_ports AS (
  SELECT p.tenant_id, p.id AS port_id, p.name, p.mac_address, p.admin_state_up
  FROM ports p
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
tenant_stats AS (
  SELECT tenant_id,
         COUNT(*) AS down_count,
         ROUND(AVG(admin_state_up)) AS avg_admin
  FROM down_ports
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
all_tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_ports
  FROM ports
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_port_count FROM all_tenant_counts
),
sg_ranked AS (
  SELECT d.tenant_id, d.port_id, d.name, d.mac_address, d.admin_state_up,
         b.host AS binding_host, b.vif_type,
         s.security_group_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.security_group_id ORDER BY d.port_id) AS sg_rank
  FROM down_ports d
  LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = d.port_id
  LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings s ON s.port_id = d.port_id
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT r.*,
         AVG(r.admin_state_up) OVER (
           PARTITION BY r.vif_type
           ORDER BY r.mac_address
           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
         ) AS window_avg
  FROM sg_ranked r
)
SELECT w.tenant_id,
       t.down_count,
       t.avg_admin,
       w.security_group_id,
       w.sg_rank,
       w.name,
       w.mac_address,
       w.admin_state_up,
       w.binding_host,
       w.vif_type,
       w.window_avg,
       w.window_avg / t.avg_admin AS normalized_ratio,
       a.total_ports,
       g.avg_port_count
FROM windowed w
JOIN tenant_stats t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id
JOIN all_tenant_counts a ON a.tenant_id = w.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN global_avg g
ORDER BY w.tenant_id, w.mac_address
